claims.statement: 69 local codec tests, including 12 rights-profile tests and 6400 individual signature bit flips in one fixture.
Ingolf Lohmann attribution and current rights notice are mandatory in each new licensed-profile element; payload rights remain separate.
All historical V1 and existing hardware/native consumers use the new profile. No automatic adoption is claimed.
The concrete Python parser and SHA-256 implementation refine the abstract Lean model for every execution.
Automatic creation and acceptance of correct adapters for every unknown future machine runtime.
Concrete hardware, QPU and analog integration, including independent calibration and end-to-end effects.
Owner term superdeterministic refers here to reproducible software control, not a proved physical superdeterminism.
Successful self-application proves every claim about the system; no such general theorem is established.
Productive exact-domain delivery, authenticated remote alarms and native EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
